Upon hearing the counsel the Court made the following
 O R D E R

Heard the learned counsel for the parties and perused the details furnished in application (IA No.
101139/2023) wherein the parties, jointly in terms of the Memorandum of Understanding dated Sonata Parashar vs Tushar Goyal on 18 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/81587385/
1 11.05.2023, prays that this Court be pleased to invoke its power under Article 142 of the Constitution and dissolve the marriage between the parties, which was solemnized on 23.02.2015.

A perusal of Memorandum of Understanding dated 11.05.2023 entered into between the parties would indicate that the parties have agreed on the terms of settlement and also to conclude the other proceedings pending against them.

In that regard, having taken note of the same, we hereby quash the below mentioned proceedings which are filed between the parties before different Courts;
(i) A complaint under Section 12 of the Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005 bearing Complaint Case No. 13307/2018 titled as Sonata Parashar v. Tushar Goyal pending before the learned Metropolitan Magistrate, Saket Courts, Delhi.
(ii) An appeal under Section 29 of the Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005 bearing C.A. No. 248/2022 titled as Sonata Parashar v. Tushar Goyal pending before the leared Additional Sessions Judge, Saket Courts, Delhi.
(iii) An FIR bearing No. 66/2020 under Sections 377,498A,406,506 and 509 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 dated 01.02.2020, P.S. Malviya Nagar, Delhi which culminated into a chargesheet under Sections 377,498A,406,506,509 and 34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 pending before the Ld.
Metropolitan Magistrate, Saket Courts, New Delhi.

In so far as the remaining proceedings which are indicated below, they shall be closed by the courts concerned before which they are pending on furnishing a copy of this Order,
(i) A Divorce Petition under S.13(1)(ia) of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 bearing HMA No.
1147/2018 titled as Sonata Parashar v. Tushar Goyal pending before the Ld. Family Court,
Gurugram, Haryana.

(ii) A Divorce Petition under S.13(1)(ia) of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 bearing HMA No.
456/2023 titled as Tushar Goyal v. Sonata Parashar pending before the Ld. Family Court,
Gurugram, Haryana.

(iii)A Civil suit bearing CS SCJ No. 1199/2022 titled as Sonata Parashar v. Tushar Goyal pending before the Ld. Civil Judge, Saket Courts, Delhi.

2
(iv) A Civil Suit bearing CS No. 1443/2020 titled as Ila Goyal v. Sonata Parashar pending before trhe Ld. Civil Judge, Gurugram, Haryana.

(v) A petition under section 482 of the Code of the Criminal Procedure, 1973 bearing Crl. M.C. No.
2594/2022 titled as Sonata Parashar v. Tushar Goyal pending before the Delhi High Court In that view of the matter, on taking note of the very fact that parties were litigating before different forums,
it would
indicate that the marriage is irretrievably broken down and therefore, we accept the prayer made in the application (IA No. 101139/2023).

Since, all the other terms and conditions have been agreed upon between the parties for separation and the marriage being unworkable, in exercise of our power under Article 142 of the Constitution, the marriage dated 23.02.2015 between the parties shall stand dissolved.
Decree shall be drawn in that regard.
The application along with the main petition stands disposed of along with pending application(s), if any.

(NISHA KHULBEY) (DIPTI KHURANA)
